ui.title: Policy Assistant with Escalation
ui.tagline: An internal policy assistant that answers only from your policies, cites them, and knows when it cannot answer: a specialist checks the exact wording, and an attached workflow drafts what it can and routes the rest to the policy owner's queue.

actions.label: Run: Escalate an unanswered question
actions.description: Called by the policy assistant when it cannot answer from the policies. Kaman drafts a best-effort answer, judges whether it is safe to send, and otherwise routes the question to the policy owner's queue.

inputs.name: question
inputs.label: Question
inputs.default: Can I carry forward more than 10 days of unused leave if my manager agrees?

inputs.name: context
inputs.label: Context
inputs.default: Policy found: carry-forward capped at 10 days; exceptions not mentioned.
